📄 Iran congratulates Spain on winning FIFA World Cup 2026

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, in separate statements, have facilitated Spain after the national football team of the European country was crowned the World Cup Champions.

In a message posted on his X account on Monday, Pezeshkian extended his greetings to the 2026 World Cup winner, saying the joy of the friendly people and government of Spain is the joy of the people and government of Iran.
​
I congratulate the people and government of Spain on the national football team's success and well-deserved championship title in the World Cup, he wrote.
​
Separately, the Iranian Parliament Speaker, in a message to his Spanish counterpart and lawmakers, cheered the Spanish national team on its victory in the FIFA World Cup, co-hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico this year.
​
Congratulating the people and the government of Spain and wishing them more success, Ghalibaf said their team's victory and championship not only made the hearts of Spaniards happy, but also the hearts of many free and independent and justice-loving nations of the world.
​
The top parliamentarian also expressed his gratitude to Spain's government and national football team for showing solidarity with the oppressed Palestinian nation, as well as for their support for Iran during the US-Israeli-imposed war.
​
Spain defeated Argentina in the final of the 2026 World Cup last night at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey, United States, winning the championship for the second time with a 1-0 victory. The team showed a spectacular performance and was able to advance to this stage with only one goal conceded during the tournament.
​
Spanish fans celebrated the occasion by waving Palestinian flags in New York's Times Square, prompting Palestinian officials to commend and congratulate the Spanish national football team on their World Cup victory.
